msg: Hi there! My boyfriend is a PADI diver and I've never tried it. How much would it be for both of us to go out one day?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

The *Dive Mini Course* is for you to try diving. Your boyfriend’s PADI certification doesn’t change the price of this plan.

• *From Cartagena:* 183 USD online or 204 USD without booking online per person. In COP, it’s 655.000 online or 727.000 without booking online per person.
• *If you’re already on the Rosario Islands:* 134 USD online or 149 USD without booking online per person. In COP, it’s 475.000 online or 528.000 without booking online per person.

Colombians and residents of Colombia pay in COP; all other international clients pay in USD. The price is the same—only the currency changes, with no discount for being Colombian.

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll send you the exact plan and booking link. 🌊

msg: we're staying at Isla Grande! he wants to dive, not the mini course haha, and I'd try the mini course. we're from Canada
reply:
Got it! Since you’re staying on Isla Grande, your boyfriend can do the certified-diver 2-dive trip, and you can try the Dive Mini Course. The online prices are *124 USD* for his 2 dives and *134 USD* for your mini course. The 2-dive trip includes gear; the mini course includes pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor. Neither plan includes lunch when you’re already on the islands.

I recommend the *2 dives in 1 day* plan in the Rosario Islands. (If you'd rather a *multi-day package* of 3+ dives, just tell me.)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: no, he dived last month. how do we pay?
reply:
International clients pay 100% by card on the website. With a foreign card, use the passport as the ID document. The online payment is recorded right away, and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If the online payment fails, the team sends a bank-transfer link, and the 10% online discount is kept. Outside that case, payment by transfer isn’t available.

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*
💰 *124 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, full diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en
---

✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
